concerns.text: FR-003 requires logging of start time, end time, and every intermediate edit attempt for each task with millisecond precision, but the only logging task (T004) records per‑edit timestamps; no task implements the start‑time/end‑time capture or the 15‑minute timeout/abort handling described in the spec’s edge cases.

FR-007 mandates that the final report contain both mean and median statistics. The report task (T009) is only required to output median fields (as enforced by the AnalysisResult contract) and does not provide a task that computes or records mean values, leaving the mean requirement uncovered.

SC-001 expects a mean‑based Wilcoxon analysis of time‑to‑success. The existing Wilcoxon task (T008) produces only median‑based results; there is no task that computes or validates the required mean statistic.

The implementation plan lists a Phase 0 for environment setup (requirements file, seed pinning, checksum logic) but the tasks document contains no corresponding task to create `requirements.txt`, set the global seed, or generate the checksum manifest.
Phase 6 in the plan describes a `human_data_collection.py` stub for ingesting real participant logs, yet the tasks list provides no task that implements, tests, or validates this stub.

The plan places the report generator under `src/report/generate_report.py`, while the tasks reference `src/report/generate_report.py` (T009) but the project tree in the plan does not contain a `report/` directory; this mismatch leaves the deliverable ambiguous and untracked by any task.

The plan states that contracts reside in `specs/001-llmxive-cognitive-load/contracts/`, whereas all tasks (e.g., T004, T010) reference contracts under `specs/001-llmxive-follow-up-extending-crafter-a-mu/contracts/`. This inconsistency means the contract files referenced by tasks may not be found at the paths declared in the plan.

The spec’s edge case for a corrupted ground‑truth vector (skip figure, log warning, adjust N) is not covered by any task; neither the validation scripts (T005/T007) nor the report generator (T009) include logic to detect or handle corrupted vectors.

The spec’s 15‑minute timeout/abort behavior (log as aborted, exclude from time‑to‑success but include max iterations) is not implemented in any task; there is no task that adds timeout handling to the logger, simulator, or analysis pipeline.
